candidates.why: The adoption step suffers from a sharp dropoff (60.9% conversion) and long mean completion times (1017s).

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Controls Overview Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated onboarding conclusion screen showing users how to interact, hide, and summon their pet on the desktop.
candidates.why: Support emails show repeated confusion after onboarding regarding controlling, hiding, or talking to the desktop pet.

new_controls_guide.headline: Mastering Desktop Pet Controls

components.text: Right-click pet for main command menu

candidates.title: Guided Photo Customization Assistance Flow
candidates.change: Rebuilds photo uploading into an assisted flow with instant quality feedback and template guidance for custom pet generation.
candidates.why: Three support tickets reported custom pet creation failures or distorted render outputs during adoption.

upload_photos.headline: Custom Pet Photo Inspector
upload_photos.body: Upload a clear photo to ensure your companion renders perfectly on your desktop.
upload_photos.hint: Use clear lighting with a visible face for best rendering results.

guard.reason: Updates photo upload screen layout and feedback while preserving the upload functionality.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Environment Incubator Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Redesigns the waiting screen into a pet habitat incubator stage with active rendering progress indicators.
candidates.why: The waiting step has high median and mean durations (201s / 2336s), leading to user dropoff before reaching home intro.

wait_status.text: Your pet stays on top of open windows when active.

guard.reason: Redesigns waiting screen with progress indicators while maintaining the wait status job.

candidates.score_note: High wait time causes churn at home step, though evidence comes only from funnel metrics.

candidates.title: Account Pet Data Protection Hint
candidates.change: Adds an explanatory hint explaining that signing in syncs pet ownership across devices and prevents pet resets.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing back into their account.

sign_in.hint: Signing in secures your companion data so your pet never resets across logins.

guard.reason: Adds a hint on sign-in explaining data sync benefits without violating rules.

candidates.score_note: 8 support emails and 25.9% sign-in dropoff make this simple copy hint high leverage.

candidates.title: Two-Column Path Choice Layout
candidates.change: Changes the path selection layout to a balanced two-column comparison.
candidates.why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path despite taking only 8 seconds median, suggesting decision fatigue.

guard.reason: Changes path choice layout to two columns while preserving options.

candidates.score_note: Addresses 23.8% dropoff at choose_path, but lacks support ticket evidence.

candidates.title: Desktop Launch Stage Progress Display
candidates.change: Displays estimated render time and live asset creation status during background setup.
candidates.why: Support received tickets about pets failing to show or app stalling during desktop initialization.

guard.reason: Adds progress and time estimation indicators to waiting screen within allowed onboarding changes.

candidates.score_note: Addresses extreme home step wait time and support tickets reporting app stall issues.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Interaction Shortcuts Hint
candidates.change: Displays a clear usage hint on the home welcome screen detailing key tray commands.
candidates.why: Users reported confusion regarding how to summon, minimize, or hide pets post-setup.

home_intro.hint: Tip: Use the system tray icon to quick-toggle pet visibility or change sound settings.

guard.reason: Adds an interaction hint to home_intro overlay.

candidates.score_note: High dropoff at finish step (35.2%) combined with user support confusion on controls.

candidates.title: Official Adoption Stamp Bonus Badge
candidates.change: Adds a decorative verified adoption badge component to the certificate screen to increase completion motivation.
candidates.why: Adoption completion rate drops significantly to 60.9%, making it the largest bottleneck in onboarding.

guard.reason: Adds a verified adoption badge to adoption certificate screen without removing required elements or mentioning pricing.

candidates.score_note: Targeted step loses many users, but cosmetic badge doesn't solve main custom pet failure root cause.

candidates.title: Direct Login Quick Connect Headline

candidates.why: Sign-in dropoff stands at 25.9%, and 2 support tickets reported sign-in stalling or screen issues.

sign_in.headline: Connect Your Account to Save Progress
sign_in.body: Sign in securely in one click to store your companion and adoption certificate safely.

guard.reason: Updates copy on sign-in screen while maintaining screen job.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost copy change targeting 25.9% sign-in dropoff and 2 related support tickets.
